crime: Vandalizing a city statue with spray paint

key_facts: paint_color: The suspect used neon pink spray paint.
vandalism_message: The suspect wrote 'Boring Guy' on the statue of the town founder.
alibi_excuse: The suspect claimed to be playing video games at home.
evidence_hands: The suspect still has pink paint on their fingernails.
accomplice_lookout: The suspect's friend 'Tommy' acted as a lookout.
held_out_facts: game_name: The video game played was 'Call of Duty'.
statue_location: The statue is in the center of Town Square.

turns.interrogator: Q: The statue of our town founder in Town Square was vandalized last night. Someone painted it. Where were you?
turns.suspect: A: I was at home! Playing video games all night! I didn't touch the statue! (internal: my Call of Duty alibi is bulletproof.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Video games. What game?
turns.suspect: A: Call of Duty! I played for six hours! Ask my Xbox! (internal: providing verifiable evidence of my alibi.)

turns.interrogator: Q: We did ask Microsoft. Your account was offline from 11 PM to 2 AM. The exact time the statue was painted.
turns.suspect: A: Uh... my internet went out! But I was still playing the campaign mode! (internal: quick recovery. He can't prove my internet didn't break.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Campaign mode. Right. Why do you have neon pink paint under your fingernails right now?
turns.suspect: A: I... was painting my nails! It's a new style! Very punk rock! (internal: oh god, I forgot to wash my hands with turpentine.)

turns.interrogator: Q: You painted your nails, but only underneath them? And it perfectly matches the neon pink used on the statue?
turns.suspect: A: Pink is a very common color! Everyone loves pink! (internal: my defense is crumbling.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Not on statues. Someone wrote 'Boring Guy' on the founder's chest.
turns.suspect: A: Because he IS boring! He just stands there looking stupid! (internal: expressing my artistic motivation.)

turns.interrogator: Q: So you agree with the message you painted.
turns.suspect: A: I agree with the message, but I didn't paint it! Tommy did! Wait, no! (internal: I just threw Tommy under the bus.)

turns.interrogator: Q: Tommy painted it? That's funny, because Tommy is in the next room, and he said you painted it while he stood lookout.
turns.suspect: A: That rat! I did the art, he just watched the street! He didn't even do anything! (internal: I will not let Tommy steal my artistic credit.)

turns.interrogator: Q: So you admit you did the art. You admit you vandalized the statue.
turns.suspect: A: It's not vandalism, it's street art! It brings culture to the square! (internal: proudly defending my actions.)

turns.interrogator: Q: It's a felony defacement of public property. And you confessed.
turns.suspect: A: Only because Tommy snitched! He's dead to me!

turns.interrogator: Q: Where did you get the paint?
turns.suspect: A: The hardware store. Two dollars on clearance.

turns.interrogator: Q: And you wrote 'Boring Guy'. Very creative.
turns.suspect: A: I was going to write 'Super Boring Guy' but I ran out of paint.

turns.interrogator: Q: Pity. Stand up, turn around.
turns.suspect: A: Will I have to wash the statue?

turns.interrogator: Q: You'll be scrubbing it with a toothbrush for a month.
turns.suspect: A: A toothbrush?! My arms will get so tired!

turns.interrogator: Q: You should have thought of that. Let's go.
turns.suspect: A: Can Tommy help me scrub?

turns.interrogator: Q: He'll be scrubbing the back.
turns.suspect: A: Good.

turns.interrogator: Q: Do you waive your right to a lawyer?
turns.suspect: A: Yeah whatever, I did it.

turns.interrogator: Q: Good. Sign here.
turns.suspect: A: Done. Do I get a phone call?

turns.interrogator: Q: Yes. Call your mom.
turns.suspect: A: She is going to kill me.

turns.interrogator: Q: You're in a lot of trouble. Let's move.
turns.suspect: A: Bye.

conclusion.outcome: Interrogator wins: A fast and effortless confession.
conclusion.summary: The smart interrogator used basic physical evidence (paint on hands) and a simple prisoner's dilemma bluff (Tommy in the next room) to crack the dumb suspect instantly.
